data: Which line represents the dataset with higher rule quality?

The caption states that there are high-quality rules on WN18RR. The graph shows two lines representing different datasets: one for WN18RR and another for FB15K-237. The blue line represents WN18RR, and the orange line represents FB15K-237. The blue line starts at a higher value than the orange line and remains above it throughout the range of the x-axis. Therefore, the blue line represents the dataset with higher rule quality.
